objective: Ten primary-paper architecture reproductions without training; incrementally improve an isolated SMPL-H candidate

protocol.inputs: Existing primary texts P02/P03/P04/P05/P07/P09/P10/P12/P14/P16 and author repositories; explicit artificial tensors for untrained forward checks
protocol.control: Keep the current FlowMesh and engineering mainline untouched; compare each original implementation with its own published configuration before project adaptation
protocol.variables: One architecture/interface change per candidate; label reduced sizes, feature-only tests, alternate assets and compatibility patches explicitly
protocol.success: For each of ten papers: method/code anchors, runnable original inference structure or explicitly unresolved resource failure, tensor/coordinate/representation contract, limitations; then verified isolated candidate revisions and architecture synthesis
checks: finite forward output and actual shapes
rotation convention and SO(3) endpoints where relevant
future-dependence and streaming state where applicable
no download of weights during random initialization
protocol.stopping_rules: Stop only the affected test on absent assets/license or numerical failure; preserve evidence and continue independent papers. No training, no random-output accuracy claims, no frozen-mainline replacement, no redistributing external code/assets
protocol.scope_boundary: Architecture reproduction is not replication of published trained performance. A component forward is not a full model forward; project adaptations remain separate from the original architecture. Do not mark the whole goal complete while any requested reproduction or architecture revision remains unresolved.
